writeup: Woot has a new VisionTek VT2500 triple-display USB-C docking station with 85W power delivery (MPN 901381, UPC 784090040145) for $58.50. Micro Center lists the exact same new dock in stock at its Austin store for $129.99, and VisionTek's own store has it available for $149.99. That is 54 percent below Micro Center and saves about $71. Woot showed 5+ left with a limit of five per customer.
